{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out sentinel values (-1) for customer_age
valid_ages = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age']

# Compute and print the mean age on valid data
mean_age = valid_ages.mean()
print(f'Mean age of customers (excluding -1 sentinels): {mean_age:.4f} years')

# Print the number of valid entries
print(f'Number of valid age entries: {len(valid_ages)}')

# Print the number of sentinel values
print(f'Number of sentinel values (-1): {len(df[df["customer_age"] == -1])}')"}
